brand.tagline: Carrom the way we play it at home. Flick, pocket, cover the queen.

onboard.langHint: You can change this any time in Settings.

s1.title: Nine, nine and the queen
s1.body: Each side has nine coins. Pocket all of yours before your opponent does. The red queen is worth 3 points to whoever covers it.

s2.title: Flick the striker
s2.body: Slide the striker along your baseline, then press it and pull back. Let go to shoot. The further you pull, the harder it goes.

s3.title: Cover the queen
s3.body: After you pocket the queen, pocket one of your own coins on the next shot to keep it. Miss, and the queen goes back to the centre.

menu.tutorialSub: A five-step guide on a real board
menu.dailySub: Clear five whites in seven shots

ai.title: Play the computer
ai.long: Pick a level from Beginner to Expert. Play one-on-one or as a team of two.

online.title: Play online
online.long: Quick match against anyone, or make a private room and send the code to friends.

local.title: Pass and play
local.long: Sit around one screen. The board turns to face whoever is playing.

practice.title: Practice
practice.long: No opponent and no limit on shots. Set up a drill and ask the coach for a line.

desc.beginner: Aims roughly and often plays a loose shot
desc.hard: Rebounds, safety play, chases the queen
desc.expert: Rarely misses and thinks a shot ahead

local.title: Pass and play
local.hint: Players take turns on this device. Partners sit opposite each other in a team game.

practice.title: Practice
practice.hint: Pick a drill. Every shot is free, and the coach can show you a line to try.

rules.title: Rules

presetHint.gedara: Home rules: queen any time, no striker penalty
presetHint.freestyle: Any coin counts: white 20, black 10, queen 50

rules.queenNeedsOwn: Queen only after your first coin
rules.shotClockHint: 30 seconds per shot. When time runs out, the turn passes.

rulesText.std1: Pocket your own coin and you shoot again.
rulesText.std2: Pocket the striker and it is a foul: one of your pocketed coins goes back to the centre, and your turn ends.
rulesText.std3: After pocketing the queen, cover it by pocketing one of your coins on the next shot, or she returns to the centre.
rulesText.std4: You cannot pocket your last coin before the queen is covered.
rulesText.std5: The board winner scores one point for every opponent coin left, plus 3 for the queen if they covered it.
rulesText.queenOwn: You must pocket one of your own coins before you can pocket the queen.
rulesText.noPenalty: No penalty coin for pocketing the striker.
rulesText.free1: Every coin counts for whoever pockets it.

game.title: Match
game.hintSling: Press the striker and pull back to aim. Release to shoot.
game.hintPoint: Tap where to aim, set power, then Strike.

hud.badPlacement: The striker can't sit on a coin. Move it along the line.
hud.badDirection: Aim forward, away from your baseline.
hud.rejected: The server didn't accept that shot. Board resynced.

foul.lastCoin: Foul: last coin before the queen

queen.early: Queen returned: pocket your own coin first

due.paid: Penalty coin returned to the board

pause.title: Paused
pause.leaveBody: This match will end and won't be saved.
pause.leaveOnline: You'll leave the room. If you don't come back within a minute, the match goes to your opponent.
pause.onlineNote: Online games keep running while this menu is open.

move.title: Place your striker
move.body: Drag the striker along your baseline, or use the Striker slider below the board.

aim.title: Aim and shoot
aim.body: Press on the striker and pull back, like a slingshot. The dashed line shows where it goes. Release to shoot.

pot.title: Pocket a coin
pot.body: Line the striker up behind the white coin so the olive ring lights up a pocket. A gentle shot is enough.

queen.title: Pocket and cover the queen
queen.body: Pocket the red queen, then pocket a white coin on your next shot to cover her.

fouls.title: Mind the fouls
fouls.body: If the striker drops into a pocket, it's a foul: a coin goes back to the centre and your turn ends. That's everything you need. Have fun!

tutorial.doneBody: Try the computer on Beginner or Easy, or invite a friend online.

results.forfeit: Won by forfeit after a disconnect.

settings.title: Settings
settings.slingHint: Press the striker, pull back and release.
settings.pointHint: Tap where to aim, set power with the slider, then press Strike.
settings.guideHint: Full shows the first contact and where the coin goes. Practice always uses Full.
settings.lowDataHint: Sends fewer aim updates online and lowers graphics
settings.serverHint: Leave empty unless you run your own Ceyrom server, for example https://carrom.example.lk

lobby.title: Play online
lobby.quickHint: Get paired with the next player waiting.
lobby.privateHint: Choose the rules and invite friends with a code.
lobby.offlineBody: Online play needs the Ceyrom server. Computer, pass-and-play and practice all work offline.

net.waitingServer: Confirming the shot with the server…

err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err.room_not_found: No room with that code. Check the letters and try again.
err.room_full: That room is full. You can still watch.
err.not_host: Only the host can start the match.
